This directory contains code from:

**CogLTX: Applying BERT to Long Texts**  
Ding et al. (2020)

Repository: https://github.com/Sleepychord/CogLTX  
License: MIT

The original CogLTX repository supports multiple NLP tasks. This project retains only the classification components.  
Some changes are done for integration purposes (Details are listed on each files)
